prompt: Create a finished illustration for a public book-summary library for adult readers. Use a calm, contemporary illustrated-book style: hand-painted gouache, soft matte pigment, restrained pencil details, and a subtle warm ivory paper texture. Use a consistent palette of muted sage and olive green, warm ochre, natural wood brown, and warm ivory, with dark brown or charcoal details. Keep saturation restrained and lighting soft and natural. Give the scene generous breathing room, a clear focal point, and simple, recognizable forms that remain readable on a phone. When people are relevant, depict believable adults with natural proportions, respectful expressions, and ordinary clothing. Use the same medium, palette, texture, and level of detail across the illustration. Avoid photorealism, glossy 3D, neon colors, cinematic effects, heavy black outlines, childish clipart, ornamental clutter, and a different art style in each panel. No readable text, captions, logos, watermarks, fake book covers, or invented author portraits. Keep all explanations and essential labels outside the generated image. Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: finished SQUARE hero illustration for a book-summary article. The supplied reference is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match its gouache, paper texture, matte pigments and gentle natural light. Do not copy its person, study desk, notebook or scene. Use a NEW concrete subject and composition appropriate to the book below. Choose a clear single scene or visual metaphor that conveys the central idea, using the summary as context. Do not render the title, author name, quotations, text, labels, equations or a book cover. No random abstract shards, generic tech networks, diagram labels, glossy objects or flat-vector icons. Avoid a person at a study desk as a default. Use people only when they help explain this particular subject. For biographies, evoke the person's work, historical setting or defining subject through places and objects, without inventing an author or historical person's likeness. Do not depict a speculative documentary event. For novels, choose an appropriate setting, object or restrained symbolic scene; preserve the work's tone without graphic violence, sexual imagery or fake covers. For scientific or medical topics, favor truthful everyday or natural objects and avoid inventing scientific diagrams, anatomy, measurements or therapeutic results. Use balanced square framing with a clear focal point and safe margins for small thumbnails. Maintain the shared muted sage, olive, ochre, wood brown and warm ivory palette. Make the illustration clearly hand-painted rather than photographic.
